# Lab 10.7: ObjectRef Multimodal Tables

## What We Are Going to Do
Build a normal table that mixes product data with ObjectRef columns that point to image files, ready for AI analysis.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Build a product table with image references.** Replace `YOUR_PROJECT`.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TABLE lab10.products_multimodal AS
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS product_id,
  REGEXP_EXTRACT(uri, r'images/(.*)\.png') AS product_name,
  ROUND(10 + RAND() * 90, 2) AS price,
  OBJ.MAKE_REF(uri, 'YOUR_PROJECT.us.lab_conn') AS image
FROM lab10.pet_images;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Fill in file details.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT product_name, price, OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(image).content_type AS type, OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(image).size AS bytes
FROM lab10.products_multimodal
LIMIT 5;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Look at the schema.** Open `products_multimodal → Schema`. `image` is a STRUCT with `uri`, `version`, `authorizer` and `details`.

4. **[SQL] Use it in a prompt (preview of Module 13).**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT product_name,
  AI.GENERATE(('Describe this product in 10 words: ', OBJ.GET_ACCESS_URL(image, 'r'))).result AS description

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| ObjectRef | STRUCT pointing to a file |
| `OBJ.MAKE_REF` | Creates a reference from a URI |
| `OBJ.FETCH_METADATA` | Fills in type and size |
| Use | Structured data and files in one table |
